# Recommended Implementation Approach

Implement an **in-memory only architecture** where PII is processed exclusively in RAM using encrypted data structures, with all data flushed after each transaction and no persistence to disk. Combine this with **comprehensive audit logging** (stored separately from PII) that records all data access and transformations without capturing sensitive values themselves. This satisfies the no-disk-storage constraint [ctx_0001] while providing the clean, auditable trail [ctx_view_0002] the team requires.
